communities.label: Military spending and economic growth
communities.interpretation: Leading papers debate growth-model specification and estimate heterogeneous economic effects of military spending using panel and country evidence.

communities.label: Defence industries and European procurement
communities.interpretation: Leading papers connect European defence policy, industrial collaboration, weapons costs and procurement efficiency.

communities.label: Terrorism, counterterrorism and economic effects
communities.interpretation: Leading papers examine terrorist recruitment, the effects of deterrence and political policies, and the economic costs of terrorism.

communities.label: Demand for military expenditure
communities.interpretation: Leading papers estimate military-spending demand and distinguish economic determinants, strategic threats and spillovers.

communities.label: Arms markets, technology and capability
communities.interpretation: Leading papers combine strategic arms trade, defence R&D, equipment quality and asymmetric arms-race models; the scope is broader than arms exports alone.

communities.label: Geopolitical risk, resources and markets
communities.interpretation: Leading papers address geopolitical-risk measures, financial-market responses and resource-related military spending; this is a mixed empirical community.

communities.label: Defence spending, debt and public budgets
communities.interpretation: Leading papers study external debt, government budget choices and interactions between military and welfare expenditure.

communities.label: Military recruitment, retention and conscription
communities.interpretation: Leading papers analyse enlistment incentives, pilot retention and changes from conscription to volunteer forces.

communities.label: Civil war and the economic costs of conflict
communities.interpretation: Leading papers review civil-war research and estimate direct, regional and neighbouring-country consequences of armed conflict.

communities.label: Third-party intervention and conflict bargaining
communities.interpretation: Leading papers use strategic conflict models to examine intervention, rebellion, territorial disputes and bargaining.

communities.label: Greek–Turkish military rivalry
communities.interpretation: Leading papers review Greek–Turkish arms-race evidence and link military spending to strategic threats and Greek economic performance.

communities.label: Aircraft replacement and defence inflation
communities.interpretation: Leading papers develop economic replacement rules for ageing aircraft and relate equipment costs to defence inflation.

communities.label: Valuing defence and security preferences
communities.interpretation: Leading papers consider the welfare case for defence, individual preferences, national-security utility and business-cycle models.

communities.label: Risk, insurance and emergency provision
communities.interpretation: Leading papers model supply interruptions, risk aversion, insurance and international public goods.

communities.label: Conflict exposure, education and economic growth
communities.interpretation: This small group connects schooling, child labour and gender differences in education with a study of violence and economic growth in Colombia.

communities.label: Armoured vehicles and casualty cost-effectiveness
communities.interpretation: This small group includes an explicit published exchange over the data and methods used to evaluate armoured tactical vehicles, together with a linked casualty-care study.

communities.label: Terrorism research and prevention methods
communities.interpretation: This small group links a taxonomy of terrorism research, a study of predictability before 9/11 and evaluation of camera surveillance. The links alone do not establish one sustained debate.

communities.label: Illicit small arms and ammunition markets
communities.interpretation: Leading papers trace illicit small-arms supply chains, ammunition diversion and market prices.

communities.label: Civil-conflict motives and economic shocks
communities.interpretation: This small group connects greed/grievance arguments, economic shocks and institutional accounts of conflict.

communities.label: Deployment selection, health and education
communities.interpretation: This small group connects selection into deployment with mental health and educational outcomes of deployment and combat.

communities.label: French First World War military casualties
communities.interpretation: Leading papers use French historical soldier records to study deaths and military executions.

communities.label: Israeli–Palestinian bargaining and proxy conflict
communities.interpretation: Leading papers model monopolization of violence, proxy-war relationships and obstacles to negotiated resolution.

communities.label: Militant groups, rivalry and targeting
communities.interpretation: Leading papers connect militant-group ethnicity and rivalry with rebel decisions to target Americans.

communities.label: Military organization and battlefield performance
communities.interpretation: Two linked papers examine battlefield success and the effects of military unionization. This small pair is a connection rather than evidence of a broad community.

communities.label: Narcotics, crime and security policy
communities.interpretation: Two linked papers model narcotics restrictions and connect international crime with European threat perceptions.

communities.label: Civil-war termination and political outcomes
communities.interpretation: Two linked papers study how civil wars end and the political consequences of different outcomes.

communities.label: Iraq mortality-survey controversy
communities.interpretation: Two linked articles scrutinize the methods, integrity and corroboration of the second Lancet Iraq mortality survey. This label describes the papers’ subjects without adjudicating their claims.

communities.label: Economic growth and interstate war
communities.interpretation: Two linked papers examine whether economic growth increases the likelihood of interstate conflict.

communities.label: Swedish military service and later earnings
communities.interpretation: Two linked studies estimate civilian earnings effects of military training and peacekeeping deployment in Sweden.

communities.label: Nuclear deterrence and defensive weapons
communities.interpretation: Two linked game-theoretic papers examine nuclear acquisition, deterrence and the consequences of asymmetric defensive shields.

communities.label: Armed violence and economic development
communities.interpretation: Two linked papers address resource dependence, sustainability and the effects of civil war on financial development.

communities.label: Corruption and procurement accountability
communities.interpretation: Two linked papers model corruption controls and the costs and benefits of procurement bid protests.

communities.label: Espionage and innovation contests
communities.interpretation: Two linked theoretical papers study economic espionage, copying and competition over innovative effort.

communities.label: Orbital debris and space security
communities.interpretation: Two linked papers examine space debris, behavioural incentives and the consequences of anti-satellite weapons.

communities.label: House raids, demolitions and conflict behaviour
communities.interpretation: Two linked studies examine household exposure to state coercion and claims about punitive demolitions and suicide bombing. The label does not establish agreement between them.

communities.label: Commodity shocks, conflict and peacekeeping
communities.interpretation: Two linked empirical papers examine commodity-price shocks, conflict intensity and the possible buffering role of UN peacekeeping.
